description: Build a formatted lesson plan from objectives, materials, activities and timing.

faqs.a: Fill in subject, grade, duration, objectives, materials and activities with times, then click Generate Plan.
faqs.q: How do I create a plan?

faqs.a: Yes — the activity list stores each activity with its duration in minutes, and the plan shows a timed schedule.
faqs.q: Can I set timings per activity?

faqs.a: Click Copy Plan to copy the formatted text, or Download to save it as a .txt file.
faqs.q: How do I copy or download the plan?

faqs.a: No — plans are generated fresh each time from your inputs. Download to keep a copy.

howto: Enter subject, grade level and duration.
List objectives and materials, one per line.
Add activities with a duration in minutes each.
Click Generate Plan, then copy or download it.
title: Lesson Plan Generator
